test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

It is better to contact__ someone who draws maps__ to get help in your research project.
solution:
The correct solution is** "Cartographer"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Someone who creates maps is referred to as a **cartographer** according to the **Oxford Dictionary of English app**.

 
 
• **Example:** Sujan is quite passionate about becoming a **cartographer**.
 
 
 
• The underlined words are asking for the person **who draws maps**.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is **3) .**

The **correct sentence** is- **It is better to contact a cartographer__ to get help in your research project.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **Calligraphist: **one who practices the art of calligraphy(producing beautiful writing, often with a special pen or brush)

 
 
• **Example: **He was also a prolific writer and a calligrapher.
 
 
 
• **Psephologist: **someone who studies elections and voting statistics
 
 
• **Example: **The psephologists tell us that the larger the constituency the larger the swing.
 
 
 
• **Lexicographer:** a person whose job is to write dictionaries 
 
 
• **Example: **Ranjan works as a translator and lexicographer.
